sources.name: main
sources.text:
rule main account
json summary = {"stages":[{"score":4}, {"score":9}]}
call unit = price account
let retry = 0
label loop
let retry = retry + 1
when done retry >= 2
goto loop
label done
emit summary.stages[0].score
return unit + summary.stages[0].score
end

sources.name: pricing
sources.text:
rule price order
let total = order.quantity * order.unit
assert total >= 0
return total
end
